_comment: Shrunk streaming scene for the Nucleo one-pass front end: V=12 (3x4 TDM), C=32 chirps, S=128 samples. Ramp, chirp period AND bandwidth halved together with the counts: fs stays 6.4 MHz and the window stays ~9.6 m (64 kept bins x 0.15 m) at 2x coarser range resolution -- bin spacing is c/(2*bandwidth), so halving only the ramp would have halved the window to 4.8 m and dropped the far target off the map. Two moving targets at comfortable amplitudes (a pipeline-composition demo, not a dynamic-range study), separated in range so their CFAR windows do not interact.
